mandatoryForEveryEpisode.backgroundQueueRoots: Enqueued before the bounded read episode; the episode must create no additional jobs.
mandatoryForEveryEpisode.receiptCustody: One financial receipt and one original-input private reply after commit; neither accepted original data nor metadata may be recomputed on replay.
mandatoryForEveryEpisode.faults: Real targeted disposable SQL triggers; explicitly remove each before retry; never production fault switches.

literalOracle.selectedContext: Must not replace the request's exact company or issuer.
literalOracle.namedRevenue: At/for/of/possessive/bare-company forms; Unrelated Holdings never substitutes the tenant binding.
literalOracle.selectors: Explicit CASH/EUR retained; explicit CALENDAR/FISCAL retained and boundedly UNAVAILABLE.
literalOracle.committedReceiptFault: work_events.event_type=query_execution_completed fails after canonical receipt/private reply commit; actual retry without original idempotency key preserves original complete query.
literalOracle.traceFault: instruction_events.phase=verifying failure remains best-effort; first read succeeds.
literalOracle.uncommittedPrivateFault: Private INSERT failure cannot leave succeeded receipt; explicit retry rearms the same receipt.
literalOracle.ancillaryFault: Private INSERT/UPDATE denied only when receipt already succeeded; canonical private insertion happens while running and survives ancillary failure.
literalOracle.sameTimeQuote: Lower UUID carries expired quote, higher UUID current; repeat with freshness reversed; both stale stays STALE; price/session/delay disagreement stays CONFLICTED.
literalOracle.scopedAuthority: Application owner role is not a business wildcard: a separate fixture employee has only real exact-resource financial grants. Test missing/relevant/unrelated deny, active/expired assignment and role/user currentness.
literalOracle.tampering: Actual private JSONB corruptions of metadata, source/meta, page/count/status, IDs, intent/outcome and financial facts must refuse replay; keeping answer.query in sync must not bypass complete validation.

acceptance: All 47 independent observations required PASS for HTTP_V3. Missing, unknown profile, NOT_RUN, duplicate IDs or any FAIL cannot qualify. SOURCE_V1 is diagnostic only.
knownIntegrationGate: Objective-loop financial subqueries currently omit workInputId, and planner/objective outer NAME authority remains unresolved. They must remain refused until the coordinator integrates exact per-query private input/principal custody and metadata-only shared observations. Simply forwarding one parent objective input to multiple different financial queries violates the one-request/receipt/reply input contract. This proposal does not edit the concurrent objective/native track.
